subject: Learning Methods
title: Your Internal Clock
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Your Internal Clock.

hook.text: Without any time cues, humans naturally settle into a cycle slightly longer than 24 hours.

buildup.text: The suprachiasmatic nucleus in the hypothalamus is your master clock. It controls body temperature, hormones,.

discovery.text: Light is the primary signal that synchronizes your clock to the 24-hour day.

twist.text: Screens at night send the wrong signal. Blue light tells your clock it's still daytime, delaying melatonin release.

climax.text: Get bright light within 30 minutes of waking. Dim lights two hours before bed.

punchline.text: Morning light. Evening dim. Your clock drives your learning.

quiz.question: What is the primary signal that synchronizes the body's circadian clock?
